description: This file provides utility functions for currency conversions and formatting, specifically converting USD to credits, parsing USD-like strings, and rendering formatted currency strings with credits. It centralizes the conversion rate and offers various formatting functions for display purposes within a React application.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on the shared rate, rounding to the nearest whole credit.

methods.name: parseUsdToNumber
methods.description: Parses a USD-like string or number into a numeric value, handling currency symbols and commas.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a numeric credits value with thousands separators and appends 'credits'.

methods.name: formatUSD
methods.description: Formats a number as USD currency string using an external formatter, with fallback for invalid input.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Formats USD with credits in parentheses, including support for credits display.

methods.name: renderUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Renders a span element showing USD and credits in a formatted string, with a tooltip.
